welcome.title: Before you start
welcome.pointAnonymous: No sign-up: you get an anonymous ID. We never ask for your email or real name.
welcome.pointShared: Your nickname and marks are visible only to the people in your rooms, and are stored on Google Firebase servers in the EU.
welcome.pointDelete: You can delete your account and all your data at any time in Settings.
welcome.termsNote: By continuing you agree to the Terms of Use. The Privacy Policy explains how your data is processed.
